title: Database Search and Filtering
description: Implement search endpoints using SQL LIKE, parameterized queries, and filtered search with multiple criteria.

steps.title: Seed data on startup
steps.description: On server startup, create a products table and seed it with sample data including name, description, category, and price fields.
hints: Create table: id, name, description, category, price
Insert 5-10 sample products with varied categories

codeTemplate.python:
from fastapi import FastAPI
import sqlite3
import os

app = FastAPI()
port = int(os.getenv('PORT', 3000))

db = sqlite3.connect(':memory:', check_same_thread=False)
db.executescript('''
  CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS products (
    id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY,
    name TEXT NOT NULL,
    description TEXT,
    category TEXT,
    price REAL
  )
''')

seed_data = [
    ('Laptop', 'High performance laptop', 'Electronics', 999.99),
    ('Desk Chair', 'Ergonomic office chair', 'Furniture', 299.99),
    ('Coffee Maker', 'Automatic drip coffee maker', 'Appliances', 49.99),
    ('Headphones', 'Wireless noise-cancelling', 'Electronics', 199.99),
    ('Notebook', '200 page spiral notebook', 'Stationery', 4.99),
]
db.executemany('INSERT INTO products (name, description, category, price) VALUES (?, ?, ?, ?)', seed_data)
db.commit()

@app.get('/health')
def health():
    return {'status': 'ok', 'seeded': True}

steps.title: Basic search endpoint
steps.description: Implement GET /search?q=term that searches product names using SQL LIKE and returns matching results sorted by name.
hints: Use LIKE with % wildcards around the query term
Parameterize the query to prevent SQL injection
Return empty array if no matches

import sqlite3
import os

db = sqlite3.connect(':memory:', check_same_thread=False)
db.executescript('''CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS products (id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY, name TEXT NOT NULL, description TEXT, category TEXT, price REAL)''')
seed_data = [('Laptop', 'High performance laptop', 'Electronics', 999.99), ('Desk Chair', 'Ergonomic office chair', 'Furniture', 299.99), ('Coffee Maker', 'Automatic drip coffee maker', 'Appliances', 49.99), ('Headphones', 'Wireless noise-cancelling', 'Electronics', 199.99), ('Notebook', '200 page spiral notebook', 'Stationery', 4.99)]
db.executemany('INSERT INTO products (name, description, category, price) VALUES (?, ?, ?, ?)', seed_data)
db.commit()

@app.get('/search')
def search(q: str = ''):
    if not q:
        return []
    cursor = db.execute('SELECT * FROM products WHERE name LIKE ? ORDER BY name', (f'%{q}%',))

    return [{'id': r[0], 'name': r[1], 'description': r[2], 'category': r[3], 'price': r[4]} for r in rows]

steps.title: Full-text search across fields
steps.description: Extend the search to match across name AND description fields using SQL LIKE with OR. Return results ordered by relevance (name matches first).
hints: Use WHERE name LIKE ? OR description LIKE ?
Order by CASE WHEN name LIKE ? THEN 0 ELSE 1 END

from fastapi import FastAPI
import sqlite3
import os

app = FastAPI()
port = int(os.getenv('PORT', 3000))

db = sqlite3.connect(':memory:', check_same_thread=False)
db.executescript('''CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS products (id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY, name TEXT NOT NULL, description TEXT, category TEXT, price REAL)''')
seed_data = [('Laptop', 'High performance laptop', 'Electronics', 999.99), ('Desk Chair', 'Ergonomic office chair', 'Furniture', 299.99), ('Coffee Maker', 'Automatic drip coffee maker', 'Appliances', 49.99), ('Headphones', 'Wireless noise-cancelling', 'Electronics', 199.99), ('Notebook', '200 page spiral notebook', 'Stationery', 4.99)]
db.executemany('INSERT INTO products (name, description, category, price) VALUES (?, ?, ?, ?)', seed_data)
db.commit()

@app.get('/search')
def search(q: str = ''):
    if not q:
        return []
    pattern = f'%{q}%'
    cursor = db.execute('''
        SELECT * FROM products
        WHERE name LIKE ? OR description LIKE ?
        ORDER BY CASE WHEN name LIKE ? THEN 0 ELSE 1 END, name
    ''', (pattern, pattern, pattern))
    rows = cursor.fetchall()
    return [{'id': r[0], 'name': r[1], 'description': r[2], 'category': r[3], 'price': r[4]} for r in rows]

steps.title: Filtered search with category
steps.description: Implement a filtered search endpoint that supports both a text query (q) and a category filter. Only return products matching both criteria.
hints: Accept q and category as query parameters
Build the WHERE clause dynamically with both conditions

codeTemplate.python:
from fastapi import FastAPI
import sqlite3
import os

app = FastAPI()
port = int(os.getenv('PORT', 3000))

db = sqlite3.connect(':memory:', check_same_thread=False)
db.executescript('''CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS products (id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY, name TEXT NOT NULL, description TEXT, category TEXT, price REAL)''')
seed_data = [('Laptop', 'High performance laptop', 'Electronics', 999.99), ('Desk Chair', 'Ergonomic office chair', 'Furniture', 299.99), ('Coffee Maker', 'Automatic drip coffee maker', 'Appliances', 49.99), ('Headphones', 'Wireless noise-cancelling', 'Electronics', 199.99), ('Notebook', '200 page spiral notebook', 'Stationery', 4.99)]
db.executemany('INSERT INTO products (name, description, category, price) VALUES (?, ?, ?, ?)', seed_data)
db.commit()

@app.get('/search')
def search(q: str = '', category: str = ''):
    sql = 'SELECT * FROM products WHERE 1=1'
    params = []
    if q:
        sql += ' AND (name LIKE ? OR description LIKE ?)'
        p = f'%{q}%'
        params.extend([p, p])
    if category:
        sql += ' AND category = ?'
        params.append(category)
    sql += ' ORDER BY name'
    cursor = db.execute(sql, params)
    rows = cursor.fetchall()
    return [{'id': r[0], 'name': r[1], 'description': r[2], 'category': r[3], 'price': r[4]} for r in rows]
